name: Supabase
symbol: pg_graphql no longer enabled by default
title: Supabase: pg_graphql no longer enabled by default (new default)
summary: On May 18, 2026, pg_graphql will not be enabled by default

name: Supabase
symbol: New public tables not exposed to Data API
title: Supabase: New public tables not exposed to Data API (new default)
summary: On May 30, 2026 this setting starts to become the default for all new projects
replacement: Add explicit Postgres GRANT statements for new tables in the public schema before the Data API can see them.

name: Supabase
symbol: log_connections default for new and Free/Pro projects
title: Supabase: log_connections default for new and Free/Pro projects (new default)
summary: Postgres log_connections defaults to off for new projects and existing Free and Pro projects from 2026-07-09, cutting log noise
replacement: Re-enable log_connections via the dashboard under Database > Settings, or programmatically via the Update postgres config Management API route.

name: Supabase
symbol: Explicit extension version clause ignored for non-superusers
title: Supabase: Explicit extension version clause ignored for non-superusers (behavior change)
summary: From 2026-08-05 the version clause is ignored and the extension's default version is installed, with a warning
replacement: Remove VERSION '...' and UPDATE TO '...' clauses from migrations, scripts, and tooling.

name: Supabase API
title: Supabase API: GET /analytics/endpoints/logs.all removed
summary: The Supabase Management API logs.all endpoint is removed on 2026-09-23. Scripts calling it must migrate to the new ClickHouse-backed logs endpoint, which accepts ClickHouse SQL only
replacement: The new ClickHouse-backed logs endpoint at analytics/endpoints/logs, which accepts ClickHouse SQL only and reads all sources through a single logs table filtered by source_name.

name: Supabase
symbol: Explicit grants required for new public tables on existing projects
title: Supabase: Explicit grants required for new public tables on existing projects (configuration change)
summary: On October 30, 2026 the setting will be applied it to all existing projects
replacement: Add explicit GRANT statements alongside ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and policy statements, or run the provided ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES revoke statements to opt in early.

name: Supabase
symbol: Four CBC-mode TLS 1.2 cipher suites on HTTP APIs
title: Supabase: Four CBC-mode TLS 1.2 cipher suites on HTTP APIs removed
summary: Starting November 10, 2026 at the earliest, Supabase will stop offering some outdated TLS configurations on project HTTP APIs (<ref>.supabase.co and custom domains
replacement: Use one of the listed GCM or CHACHA20-POLY1305 TLS 1.2 cipher suites, or TLS 1.3
